findings.exact_supporting_passage: All other services will be unavailable.

findings.publisher: Winslow Indian Health Care Center, Inc.
findings.title: Dilkon Medical Center suspends wound care, podiatry and dental services for November 3
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Dental, Podiatry, and Wound Care services will be CLOSED.

coverage_notes.search_quality: All 12 searches executed. Results were often stale, overseas, broad or irrelevant; limited recall particularly for territories, ambulance/air-medical, dialysis and oncology. Official CMS index and official rural care-provider advisory were accessible. This is a bounded supplementary search and not exhaustive national coverage.
coverage_notes.controls: No article approval, public publication, schedule modification, or task disabling. Findings are pending_review. Exactly one new watch heartbeat created on ops/watch-ledger.
